title: Metadata Entry Schema
description: Schema for .obsidian/github-sync-metadata.json entries: path, sha, dirty, justDownloaded, lastModified track sync state for each vault file.

steps.description: Path and sha: path identifies the vault file, sha is null for agent writes until plugin fills it.
Dirty flag: dirty true means the file needs sync, justDownloaded false means it was not just pulled.
Timestamp: lastModified is Unix time in milliseconds when the file was last changed.
